units.source_text: 房东姑娘走远了，变小了，变成像灰尘一样的小了。

en.t: The landlord's daughter walked farther away, grew smaller, and became as tiny as dust.

units.source_text: 姑娘既然被金阁拒绝，也就被我的人生拒绝。

en.t: Since the girl had been rejected by the Golden Pavilion, she was also rejected by my life.

units.source_text: 处处被美紧密地包围，我又怎能向人生伸手呢？

en.t: Surrounded everywhere so tightly by beauty, how could I reach out toward life?

units.source_text: 就是从美的立场来看，它也有权利要求我死了这条心吧。

en.t: Even from the standpoint of beauty, it surely had the right to demand that I give up that desire.

units.source_text: 用一只手去触摸永远，另一只手去触摸人生，这是不可能的。

en.t: It is impossible to touch eternity with one hand and life with the other.

units.source_text: 我觉得对待人生的行为的意义，倘使在于对一瞬间发警忠实，并让这一瞬间止步的话，

en.t: I felt that if the meaning of an act toward life lay in being faithful to one instant and making that instant stand still,

units.source_text: 或许金阁会知悉这种情况，短暂地取消对我的疏远，

en.t: perhaps the Golden Pavilion would understand this and briefly set aside its estrangement from me,

units.source_text: 而亲自此做这一瞬间前来告诉我，我对人生的渴望是徒然的。

en.t: and would itself become that instant, come to me, and tell me that my longing for life was futile.

units.source_text: 在人生中，化做永恒的瞬间可以使我们陶醉，

en.t: In life, an instant transformed into eternity can intoxicate us,

units.source_text: 然而比起这时的金阁这种化做瞬间的永恒的姿态来，它是微不足道的。

en.t: yet compared with the Golden Pavilion at that moment, eternity transformed into an instant, it was insignificant.

units.source_text: 美的永恒的存在正是在这种时候就会真正阻碍我们的人生、使生受到毒害。

en.t: It is precisely at such times that the eternal existence of beauty truly obstructs our lives and poisons life itself.

units.source_text: 生让我们从夹缝中急机到的瞬间的美在这样的毒害面前简直不是对手，

en.t: The momentary beauty that life lets us seize from between the cracks is no match at all for such poison,

units.source_text: 将会马上崩溃、毁灭，生本身也整个暴露在毁灭的淡菜色的光辉下。

en.t: and will immediately collapse and perish, while life itself is wholly exposed beneath the pale shell-colored radiance of destruction.
